commit_message: Fix Codex ACP process runtime construction
pr_title: GameEngine: integrate ACP external agent runtime
pr_body:
## Summary

- integrate the provider-neutral ACP core transport and AgentHost bridge
- add Claude and Codex ACP adapters on the same common process transport
- add formal fail-closed `session/set_config_option` support for Codex mode/model/reasoning preferences
- keep Agent Host authoritative for permissions, MCP writes, validation, and completion

## Integration

Goose Managed Local, AI Studio execution routing, benchmark migration, Cargo.lock, and final validation continue on this Draft integration branch.

## Validation

Dispatcher Windows Validation is required after this integration slice; the final integrated head is authoritative.
